en.summary: An RPG Maker MV fan remake of the NES Dragon Warrior (Dragon Quest I): a full recreation of the Alefgard journey — Brecconary, Tantegel Castle, Erdrick's Sword, and the final battle with the Dragonlord. An unofficial fan work.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼作者 AdanRafli 的奇幻 RPG：英雄 Liyue 抵达森林小镇，遭遇自称野蛮人的怪人，冒险就此展开；武器店与防具店、抽卡与变身系统俱全。

en.summary: An Indonesian fantasy RPG by AdanRafli: the hero Liyue arrives in a forest town and crosses paths with a strange man who calls himself a Barbarian; weapon and armor shops, a gacha system, and transformations round out the small adventure.

ja.summary: インドネシアの作者 AdanRafli によるファンタジーRPG。英雄 Liyue が森の町に到着し、自らをバーバリアンと名乗る怪人と出会い、冒険が始まる。武器屋・防具屋、ガチャや変身システムを備える。

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语奇幻 RPG：南方村庄正为丰收节做准备，主角卷入村庄的日常与支线——寻找失踪的熊、帮助邻里，日夜流转中推进剧情。

en.summary: A Russian fantasy RPG: the southern village prepares for the Harvest Festival while the hero gets drawn into village life and side quests — a lost bear, neighbours in need — as day turns to night.

ja.summary: ロシア語のファンタジーRPG。南の村が収穫祭の準備を進めるなか、主人公は村の日常とサイドクエスト——行方不明の熊、困っている隣人たち——に巻き込まれ、昼夜の移ろいのなかで物語が進む。

en.summary: The final chapter of DirectDogman's satirical Five Nights at Freddy's fan trilogy: in 2023, Jack buys a Start Your Own Freddy Fazbender's Pizza Kit and runs his own pizzeria — salvaging animatronics from abandoned locations by day — and enters the Flipside, where souls linger, to complete six redemption missions against Henry Miller. Arcade-machine RPG battles included.

ja.summary: DirectDogman による『Five Nights at Freddy's』の風刺同人三部作の最終章。2023年、主人公 Jack はフレディ・ファズベンダー・ピザ店キットを購入し、自分のピザ店を経営しながら廃墟となった旧店舗からアニマトロニクスを回収する。夜には魂が集う「裏側」（Flipside）に入り、6つの救済ミッションをこなして Henry Miller に立ち向かう。アーケードマシンでのRPGバトルも備える。

en.summary: A Cantonese two-player co-operative escape game: under a hypnotist's guidance, two players enter a dream and wake in an old mansion, where they must split up and cooperate through guest rooms, the basement, game rooms, and the master bedroom to uncover the mansion's secret.

ja.summary: 広東語の2人協力型脱出ゲーム。催眠術師の誘導で夢に入った2人のプレイヤーは古い大邸宅で目覚め、客室、地下室、ゲーム部屋、主人の部屋の仕掛けを分担して解き、邸宅の秘密を探る。

dungeons-crawler-something.assessmentNote: WebRPG mirror only (no sourceRepo, no sourceHeadSha, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 23 maps / 336 events / 857 dialogue lines — a complete dungeon crawl (five cave types, crystal restoration, Thieves' Guild + tower bosses, secret boss); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

translatedTitles.ja: ダンジョンズ・クローラー・サムシング

zh-Hans.summary: 一款地牢探索 RPG：洞窟中的水晶相继失灵，冒险者公会派出小队深入石窟、下水道、冰窟、熔岩洞与诅咒洞窟，修复水晶，挑战盗贼公会与高塔之主，并有隐藏 Boss。

en.summary: A dungeon-crawling RPG: the crystals in the caves have failed, and the Adventurers' Guild sends a party deep into stone, sewer, ice, lava, and cursed caves to restore them, taking on the Thieves' Guild and the masters of the tower — with a secret boss waiting.

ja.summary: ダンジョン探索RPG。洞窟のクリスタルが次々と機能を失い、冒険者ギルドは一行を石窟、下水道、氷窟、溶岩洞、呪いの洞窟へ送り込む。クリスタルを修復し、盗賊ギルドと塔の主たちに挑む。隠しボスも待ち受ける。

eduventure.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; the Devpost 'Edu-venture' is a different 2017 Unity game); game data 8 maps / 160 events / 812 dialogue lines — subject-themed quiz stages with stage-progress switches; the 'dick' keyword hit is the quiz answer 'Moby-Dick', harmless; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 印尼教育 RPG：玩家在校园中穿梭于语言、艺术与技术等科目关卡，通过答题推进——莎士比亚、文学名著等课堂问答构成主要玩法。

en.summary: An Indonesian educational RPG: explore a school through subject-themed stages — language, arts, technology — answering classroom quiz questions (Shakespeare, classic literature, and more) to progress.

ja.summary: インドネシアの教育RPG。言語、芸術、技術などの科目別ステージが並ぶ校舎を巡り、シェイクスピアや古典文学などの授業クイズに答えて進む。

el-fili.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (0 stars, no README, no Steam/itch/reviews; web search returns only study material on Rizal's novel); game data 21 maps / 220 events / 693 dialogue lines adapting El Filibusterismo (steamboat arrival, churches, jails, forests, wedding venue); opening monologue is Tagalog; en title 'Reign of Greed' is the novel's English alternative title (also the old meta title field); zh-Hans title left blank (no verifiable Chinese title); rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 改编自菲律宾民族英雄黎刹 1891 年小说 El Filibusterismo 的 RPG：被认为已死的 Ibarra 以珠宝商 Simoun 的身份归来，誓要颠覆殖民统治；玩家乘蒸汽船抵达，在教堂、监狱与森林之间推进革命剧情。

en.summary: An RPG adapting José Rizal's 1891 novel El Filibusterismo: Ibarra, believed dead, returns as the jeweller Simoun, bent on overturning colonial rule; arrive by steamboat and push the revolutionary plot through churches, jails, and forests.

ja.summary: フィリピンの国民的英雄ホセ・リサールの1891年の小説『El Filibusterismo』を題材にしたRPG。死んだと思われていた Ibarra は宝石商 Simoun として帰国し、植民地支配の転覆を誓う。蒸気船で到着し、教会、牢獄、森を巡りながら革命の物語が進む。

el-redentor-mistico.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is two lines, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 21 maps / 830 events / 2321 dialogue lines — a complete RPG arc (shipwreck start, Clariate kingdom, Despaire ruins, castle tower, Hephaestus volcano, Dark Kingdom, Ending switch); dialogue is Spanish; translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

en.summary: A Spanish final-degree-project fantasy RPG (UOC): after a shipwreck, the hero adventures across the Kingdom of Clariate, the Ruins of Despaire, the Volcano of Hephaestus, and the Dark Kingdom, travelling with companions Fanny, Markius, and Figur to confront a demonic entity and reach the ending.

ja.summary: スペイン語の卒業制作（UOC）ファンタジーRPG。難破した主人公は Clariate 王国、Despaire 遺跡、Hefesto 火山、闇の王国を巡り、Fanny、Markius、Figur ら仲間とともに悪魔の存在に立ち向かい、結末へと進む。

eles-ainda-estao-nas-paredes.assessmentNote: GitHub repo + webrpg mirror only (README is two lines, no Steam/itch/reviews); game data 25 maps / 293 events / 792 dialogue lines — a complete haunted-mansion adventure (living room, basement maze, dream room, old-man/rats/face scenes, kitchen, office, library); dialogue is Portuguese (System.json locale is the RPG Maker default en_US); translated titles are non-official; rating blank; popularity 1.

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语恐怖冒险游戏：玩家走进一栋闹鬼的大宅，穿过客厅、地下室迷宫与走廊，经历梦境房间、老人、老鼠与面孔等场景，在厨房、办公室与图书馆之间追寻“墙里的东西”。

en.summary: A Portuguese horror adventure: step into a haunted mansion and cross the living room, the basement maze, and the corridors, living through the dream room, the old man, the rats, and the face scenes, and searching the kitchen, office, and library for what is still in the walls.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のホラーアドベンチャー。呪われた館に足を踏み入れ、居間、地下室の迷宮、廊下を進み、夢の部屋、老人、ネズミ、顔の場面を経て、台所、書斎、図書室で「壁の中にまだいるもの」を追う。

en.summary: An English visual novel: a school-set family drama told across 1,823 dialogue lines — classrooms, the music practice room, and home, with Dad, Anne, a dinner-table confrontation, and a lurking Shadow Figure.

ja.summary: 英語のビジュアルノベル。学校を舞台にした家族ドラマで、1,823行の台詞が教室、音楽練習室、家を貫く。父、Anne、夕食の対峙、そして忍び寄る影の人物。

en.summary: A Fallout-flavoured monster-catching RPG: set out from Ember Town, cross Boston and the Wasteland, and enter Vault 111; pick a starter monster, battle enemies along the way, and navigate a Pip-Boy-style menu.

ja.summary: フォールアウト風のモンスター収集RPG。Ember の町から出発し、ボストンと荒野を越えて Vault 111 へ。最初のモンスターを選び、道中の敵と戦い、Pip-Boy 風メニューを使いこなす。

en.summary: A Traditional Chinese English-learning RPG (trial version): adventure through Hoodie Village and the BM Forest while learning English vocabulary through level quizzes — review scoring, boss levels, and campfire chats between battles.

ja.summary: 繁体字中国語の英語学習RPG（体験版）。フーディ村と BM の森を冒険しながら、レベルクイズで英単語を学ぶ。復習の採点、ボスレベル、焚き火の会話を交えて、戦いながら単語を覚える。

zh-Hans.summary: 葡萄牙语解谜冒险游戏：玩家来到 Vila Fuya 村，在 Diane、Mairla、Sarah 等人的屋子之间穿梭，解开门、按钮、石头、时钟与密码门构成的谜题链，深入高塔、监狱与迷宫。

en.summary: A Portuguese puzzle adventure: arrive in Vila Fuya and move between the houses of Diane, Mairla, Sarah, and the others, solving a puzzle chain of doors, buttons, stones, a clock, and a password door, down into the tower, the prison, and the labyrinth.

ja.summary: ポルトガル語のパズルアドベンチャー。Vila Fuya 村に到着し、Diane、Mairla、Sarah らの家々を巡りながら、扉、ボタン、石、時計、暗証番号の扉からなる謎解きの連鎖を解き、塔、牢獄、迷宮へと進む。

en.summary: A children's maze puzzle game: each level is a maze with a small visible range around the character — collect 4 treasures, find the trap door to the next level, and race the timer, with a short story before each level and a final sequence to close it out.

ja.summary: 子ども向け迷路パズルゲーム。各レベルは視界の限られた迷宮で、4つの宝物を集め、罠の扉から次のレベルへ。タイマーが刻むなか、各レベルの前に短い物語があり、最終シークエンスで締めくくる。

en.summary: A large Spanish fantasy RPG: cross the four elemental labyrinths — fire, ice, poison, and snow — storm the three-floor demon castle, and pass through ancient ruins, a school, and a fishing village, fighting turn-based battles alongside Maria, Bryans, and David.

ja.summary: スペイン語の大作ファンタジーRPG。火・氷・毒・雪の4つの元素迷宮を越え、3階建ての魔王城に攻め込み、古代遺跡、学校、漁村を巡りながら、Maria、Bryans、David ら仲間とターン制バトルを繰り広げる。

etudes01.assessmentNote: WebRPG mirrors only (no README on one fork, Next.js boilerplate README on the other, no Steam/itch/reviews); both forks carry byte-identical game data (5 maps / 69 events / 152 dialogue lines, same map names, switches, and variables) — one game, two instances; developers left blank (both forks are personal-site hosts, author unconfirmed); translatedTitles are non-official (zh-Hans is a literal translation of Études, ja is katakana); rating blank; popularity 1.

en.summary: A Chinese bite-size RPG: accept a commission and explore between the sky temple, the ruins, and the swamp — a short, complete adventure from the opening lines to the ruins' depths.

ja.summary: 中国語の小品RPG。依頼を受け、空中神殿、遺跡、沼沢を巡る短くも完結した冒険。開幕の言葉から遺跡の奥へと物語が進む。
